title: 品格教育：感恩
footer: Teacher Dom · Character Education: Gratitude 品格教育：感恩

slides.eyebrow_en: The people who make a community

strip.en: years of people who built this school
strip.zh: 年來蓋起這所學校的人

strip.en: thank-you card from each of you

slides.head_en: Cities Are Places. Communities Are People.

lines.en: Last class, we met the old places of Changhua.
lines.zh: 上一節，我們認識了彰化的老地方。

lines.en: Now let's meet the people who take care of them.
lines.zh: 這一節，來認識照顧這些地方的人。

slides.ask_en: Before 9:30 this morning, who did something for you?
slides.ask_zh: 今天早上九點半以前，有誰為你做了什麼？

slides.body_en: Gratitude means noticing what other people do for you — and then saying thank you, or giving something back.
slides.body_zh: 感恩，就是注意到別人為你做了什麼——然後說聲謝謝，或是回饋一點什麼。

prompts.en: Stand up if someone made breakfast for you today.
prompts.zh: 今天有人幫你準備早餐的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if a crossing guard helped you this morning.
prompts.zh: 今天早上有導護幫你過馬路的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you said thank you to them.
prompts.zh: 而且有跟他們說謝謝的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: So many people help us every day. We just don't always notice.
slides.punch_zh: 每天有好多人在幫我們，只是我們不一定注意到。

slides.q_en: Riddle: I stand at the school gate every morning, rain or shine. I stop the cars so you can cross. Who am I?
slides.q_zh: 猜猜我是誰：不管晴天雨天，我每天早上都站在校門口，攔下車子讓你過馬路。
slides.explain_en: A crossing guard! Many are volunteers — they stand in the rain for you.
slides.explain_zh: 導護！很多是志工——下雨天也為你站在那裡。

slides.q_en: Riddle: I start work before you wake up. I cook lunch for the whole school. Who am I?
slides.q_zh: 猜猜我是誰：你還沒起床我就開始工作，我為全校煮午餐。
slides.explain_en: A school cook! Next time you eat lunch, think about whose hands made it.
slides.explain_zh: 午餐廚工！下次吃午餐時，想想是誰的手做出來的。

slides.head_en: Why Does Changhua Still Thank Dr. Lai He?
slides.head_zh: 為什麼彰化人到現在還在感謝賴和？
slides.body_en: Lai He studied at your school and became a doctor in Changhua. Poor patients who could not pay wrote him a note: “I will pay you later.”
slides.body_zh: 賴和是你們學校的校友，後來在彰化當醫生。付不出錢的窮人，會寫一張借據給他：「我以後再還。」

slides.q_en: At the end of every year, what did Dr. Lai do with those notes?
slides.q_zh: 每到年底，賴和醫師怎麼處理那些借據？

options.en: He put them on the wall
He sent them to the police

slides.explain_en: He burned them, so no poor family had to start the new year in debt. People called him “the Matsu of Changhua.”
slides.explain_zh: 他把借據全部燒掉，讓窮人不用「欠錢過年」。大家叫他「彰化媽祖」。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: You only need to say thank you for big things.
items.zh: 只有大事才需要說謝謝。
items.note_en: Small things count too — like holding a door.
items.note_zh: 小事也算——像是幫你扶門。

items.en: Saying thank you can make YOU happier, too.
items.zh: 說謝謝也會讓自己更快樂。
items.note_en: Scientists have studied it: grateful people often feel happier.
items.note_zh: 科學家研究過：懂得感恩的人通常比較快樂。

items.note_en: Dr. Lai showed it with actions. So can you.
items.note_zh: 賴和用行動表現。你也可以。

items.en: Saying thank you takes a lot of time.
items.note_zh: 五秒鐘就夠了。今天就試試看！

items.zh: 我真的很感謝你的幫忙。

items.en: We couldn't do it without you.

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many community helpers in English as you can. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「社區裡幫助我們的人」越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：16 個

slides.prompt_en: Who is one person in our school or community you want to thank?
slides.prompt_zh: 學校或社區裡，你最想感謝的一個人是誰？
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.tip_en: Give it to them yourself — today!

slides.head_zh: 今天就可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Say thank you to a helper — and use their name.
items.zh: 向一位幫助你的人說謝謝——叫出他的名字。

items.en: Give your card to the person you wrote it for.
items.zh: 把卡片親手交給你寫給的那個人。

items.en: Do one small thing for someone else, like Dr. Lai did.
items.zh: 像賴和一樣，為別人做一件小事。

slides.q_en: Riddle: When you feel sick or fall down at school, I take care of you. Who am I?
slides.q_zh: 猜猜我是誰：你在學校不舒服或跌倒時，我會照顧你。
slides.explain_en: The school nurse! Have you ever said thank you to them?
slides.explain_zh: 護理師！你有跟他說過謝謝嗎？

slides.q_en: Dom's neighbors in California say “gracias” every day. Which language is it?
slides.q_zh: Dom 在加州的鄰居每天都說「gracias」。那是哪一種語言？
slides.explain_en: Spanish! Merci is French, danke is German, and arigatō is Japanese.
slides.explain_zh: 西班牙文！Merci 是法文，danke 是德文，arigatō 是日文。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Chungshan Elementary column. Tell Dom who you thanked today.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到中山國小那一欄，告訴 Dom 你今天感謝了誰。

slides.big_en:
Every community is built
by many hands.
slides.big_zh: 每一個社區，都是很多雙手一起蓋起來的。
